# Wetland WaterAid reference kit
Research prototype v0.3.0, 2026-10-17. Not official WaterAid guidance.
Read /brand-brief.md, /v1/tokens.json, /v1/assets.json and /v1/sources.json.
Keep official statements, observed website styling and proposed Wetland conventions distinct.
Do not infer font or logo permissions. Use fallback fonts until licensed.
Never describe Water Care Canada or Kijana fictional challenge data as WaterAid facts.
Read-only MCP endpoint: /mcp.

- /guide.html — complete styled reading and print edition
- /fonts/OFL.txt — bundled Noto Sans open font licence

## Agent integration

Read-only Streamable HTTP MCP: /mcp
Before building, read the brand system and UI guidance, then select exact asset URLs from the catalogue. Preserve aspect ratios, backgrounds and source attribution. Dashboard pack: /assets/wateraid-dashboard-assets.zip

PDFs and documents: call get_document_guidance before generation. Embed actual artwork, follow /v1/document-profile.json and render-check the export. Reference: /documents/wetland-one-pager-reference.pdf. Reusable generator: /documents/pdf-starter.zip.
